## Technical Stack & Competencies
- Core Languages: Go (Golang), TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML5, CSS3
- Frontend Architecture: Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS
- Backend & Systems: Go standard library, concurrency patterns, Node.js, Express.js, SQLite, NGINX
- DevOps & Homelab: Docker, Linux (Synology DSM / Debian bare-metal runner), Forgejo Git, GitHub Actions, Git

## Key Projects
- kv-file (https://github.com/vndangkhoa/kv-file): High-performance self-hosted file manager with macOS Miller Columns, Windows Explorer view, and real-time synchronization. Built with Go & TypeScript.
- kv-netflix (https://github.com/vndangkhoa/kv-netflix): Streaming application and media UI interface experiment.
- Homelab Node: Private bare-metal cloud running on Synology NAS hosting private Forgejo Git server, automated CI runner cluster, reverse proxy, and storage services.

## Repository Architecture (vndangkhoa/vndangkhoa)
- Purpose: GitHub Profile README repository rendered on https://github.com/vndangkhoa.
- README.md: Main profile document featuring custom Homelab Terminal and Bento Grid telemetry.
- assets/terminal.svg: Standalone SVG/CSS animated terminal window graphic.
- .github/workflows/update-project.yml: Automated cron job running every 6 hours to fetch latest active project from GitHub API and update README.md, then syncs to Forgejo.
- .github/workflows/snake.yml: Automated cron job generating contribution snake SVG to the `output` branch.
- .github/scripts/update_latest_project.py: Python script that safely updates the `<!-- LATEST_REPO:START -->` dynamic block.
- AGENTS.md: Comprehensive guide for AI coding assistants and autonomous agents.
